verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels remain dark across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising produced zero spend and zero leads — organic Google Business Profile activity is the sole demand driver. Combined, your three locations generated 401 Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days, including 23 calls, 257 direction requests, and 121 website clicks. O'Hare Precision is the strongest performer with 203 actions and a 3.7% week-over-week GBP gain, while Forte Metals saw a significant 76.92% week-over-week surge in GBP engagement before going quiet over the last three days; Advance Grinding's GBP activity is down 16.67% week-over-week. With organic signals beginning to soften at the tail end of the period, reactivating paid campaigns is the priority to ensure captured search intent converts into leads next period.
